topic: Deploy your first project (re-upload in the new style)

cover.concept: One surreal object: an open laptop sealed under a tall glass bell jar on a white pedestal, nobody else can reach it.

slides.label: Deploying
slides.idea: Deploying means a real link anyone can open, not localhost

slides.label: Pick a host
slides.idea: Pick the host by what you built: HTML on GitHub Pages, React on Vercel or Netlify, backend on Render (re-check free tiers on the day)

slides.label: Repo to link
slides.idea: Four steps: push (without .env), import, add your keys, deploy

slides.label: First deploy
slides.idea: Your first deploy will break: fix the localhost URL and the missing key

slides.label: Free tiers
slides.idea: Free apps sleep when idle; the first visit is slow (re-check the limit)

slides.label: Résumé
slides.idea: Put the live link on your résumé and in the repo's About box
friend who says "it works on my laptop"

images.prompt: Photoreal surreal studio still life, magazine-ad quality, soft light from above, subtle film grain. An open silver laptop, its screen glowing softly, sealed under a tall glass bell jar on a white plinth, against a seamless dusty-blue backdrop. The plinth and jar sit in the lower 60% of the frame; the top 35% is plain empty backdrop. Portrait 2:3, natural colours. No readable text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no faces, no watermark.
